title: Google Disbands AI System AlphaFold Team, Shifts Focus to Gemini

content_html:
A Nobel Prize-winning achievement is being quietly dismantled by its own creator. According to media reports, Google's AI laboratory DeepMind has disbanded the team behind AlphaFold—the system that predicted the three-dimensional structure of proteins, which brought CEO Demis Hassabis and research scientist Jiaopeng Jiang to the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry podium.

Over the past year, this quiet dismantling has unfolded gradually through personnel changes. Most of the original authors of the AlphaFold paper have been reassigned to other teams; among those still full-time employees at DeepMind, nearly a quarter have left the company entirely. Those who remain have been assigned to projects centered around the Gemini large language model, or new areas such as enzyme design, nuclear fusion, and genomics; others have moved to Isomorphic Labs, a drug discovery company under Alphabet.

Pushmeet Kohli, DeepMind's vice president of research, revealed the essence of this restructuring. He founded and led the "AI for Science" team, which had set a nine-year plan: focusing on major scientific challenges and ensuring each project revolved around clear objectives. He now admits that this strategy has changed. DeepMind no longer focuses solely on single scientific problems like protein folding, but instead shifts its focus to building systems driven by Gemini that assist scientists and eventually automate parts of the research process. At the same time, it is also competing with OpenAI and Anthropic for the most advanced AI agents.

The most noticeable talent drain occurred within the core team. Early this year, Jiang and another AlphaFold researcher, Adler, joined Google's "Code Strike" team—a group formed to catch up with Anthropic and OpenAI and enhance AI programming capabilities. Last month, Jiang announced his departure to join Anthropic, while Adler and AlphaFold colleague Pritzel followed suit. A DeepMind employee who did not want to be named said these three were "key, important, and core members," and their departure caused a stir within the company.

content_html_zh:
一项诺贝尔奖获奖成果正在被它的创造者悄悄拆毁。 据媒体报道，谷歌人工智能实验室 DeepMind 解散了 AlphaFold 背后的团队，该系统是预测蛋白质三维结构的系统，该系统将首席执行官 Demis Hassabis 和研究科学家 Jiaopeng Jiang 带到了 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖的领奖台上。

过去一年来，这种悄然的解散是通过人事变动逐步展开的。 AlphaFold论文的大部分原作者已被重新分配到其他团队；在 DeepMind 的全职员工中，近四分之一已经完全离开公司。 留下来的人被分配到以 Gemini 大语言模型为中心的项目，或者酶设计、核融合和基因组学等新领域；其他人则转移到了 Isomorphic Labs，这是 Alphabet 旗下的一家药物发现公司。

DeepMind 研究副总裁 Pushmeet Kohli 揭示了这次重组的本质。 他创立并领导了“AI for Science”团队，该团队制定了九年计划：专注于重大科学挑战，确保每个项目都围绕明确的目标展开。 他现在承认这一策略已经改变。 DeepMind 不再仅仅关注蛋白质折叠等单一科学问题，而是将重点转向构建由 Gemini 驱动的系统，以帮助科学家并最终实现部分研究过程的自动化。 同时，它也在与OpenAI和Anthropic争夺最先进的AI代理。

最明显的人才流失发生在核心团队内部。 今年年初，Jiang 和另一位 AlphaFold 研究员 Adler 加入了谷歌的“Code Strike”团队，该团队是为了追赶 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 并增强 AI 编程能力而成立的。 上个月，Jiang 宣布离职加入 Anthropic，而 Adler 和 AlphaFold 的同事 Pritzel 也紧随其后。 一位不愿透露姓名的DeepMind员工表示，这三人是“关键、重要、核心成员”，他们的离职在公司内部引起了轰动。
